label: GO step near episode end (trial >= 92) after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass) and almost only in episode trials 90-99 (99.6% of mass), where the value head is low (all activations have value < 5.22). Within that late-episode GO window it is selective for the previous trial being a2 -> S2 common and unrewarded (prev_reward 0 carries 97.5% of mass; prev_action 2 carries 87%). All predicate variables are observed. Dev F1 0.68 (P 0.72, R 0.65, mass recall 0.83). The top quartile is 93% covered. Magnitude grows toward the last trials and over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 choices; the strongest activations are at trial +1 after 2-3 losses in a row. Misses are weak activations, e.g. after unrewarded a1 or rare trials, or at trials 88-91. False positives are mostly cases where the trial two back was rewarded. It never fires at D1 or D2, after a rewarded trial (only 2.5% of mass), or before about trial 88. The phase/late-episode/a2-loss conjunction is clear, but the asymmetry (a2 only) and the soft onset make it only partially explained.
